papers.title: Attention Is All You Need
papers.summary: Introduces the Transformer architecture — pure attention, no recurrence. The single most influential ML paper of the decade.

papers.title: BERT: Pre-training of Deep Bidirectional Transformers
papers.summary: Bidirectional pre-training with masked language modeling. Set the template for the modern NLP pipeline.

papers.title: Language Models are Few-Shot Learners (GPT-3)
papers.summary: 175B-parameter language model demonstrating emergent in-context learning. The paper that kicked off the LLM era.

papers.title: Deep Residual Learning for Image Recognition (ResNet)
papers.summary: Skip connections enabling networks 100+ layers deep. Won ImageNet 2015, made very deep nets trainable.

papers.title: An Image is Worth 16x16 Words (Vision Transformer)
papers.summary: Pure transformer for image classification, treating image patches as tokens. Closed the gap between vision and language architectures.

papers.title: Learning Transferable Visual Models From Natural Language Supervision (CLIP)
papers.summary: Joint text-image embedding trained on 400M web pairs. Foundation for DALL·E, Stable Diffusion, and modern multimodal models.

papers.title: Chain-of-Thought Prompting Elicits Reasoning in Large Language Models
papers.summary: Show-your-work prompting unlocks reasoning in LLMs. Spawned the agent / reasoning era.

papers.title: Training language models to follow instructions (InstructGPT)
papers.summary: RLHF turning a base LM into a helpful assistant. Direct ancestor of ChatGPT.

papers.title: LLaMA: Open and Efficient Foundation Language Models
papers.summary: Open-weight foundation models that catalyzed the open-source LLM ecosystem.

papers.title: ImageNet Classification with Deep Convolutional Neural Networks (AlexNet)
papers.summary: The deep learning breakout: GPU-trained CNN crushed ImageNet 2012. Started the deep learning revolution.
